correctness.rationale: For every n>=5 the marked 3/4 vertices and support of the universal twins determine the exact dynamics of each color lineage, so representative preperiod and period are invariant under multiplicities. All 189/567 finite signatures are exhaustively classified by an executable direct neighbor rule, yielding the ten coefficient triples; standard exact surjection weights transform these into the displayed 20 full-state formulas. A separate direct functional-graph enumeration checks every cell for all n=5..9 and both graph types, 58806 states. Sharp bound 4 follows from positive last-cell coefficients. n=4 explicitly excluded.

value.rationale: The two deletion patterns are the minimal two nonisomorphic ways to lose two edges from a clique; the finding gives complete exact time-resolved dynamics for both infinite families and a provable opposite-direction change in orbit count and extinction basin. The all-state ten-cell classification and final-delay partition are not routine consequences of qualitative GHM fixation criteria or a known table recomputation. Individual orbit basins and higher thresholds remain unproved and unclaimed.
